title: plugbricks status --runtime --json
description: What the runtime really runs for a platform, next to what platform.json declares. Version 1. Key names are stable; a new key may be added in version 1, a key is never renamed or removed without a new version. No field holds a time, a log line, an environment variable or a secret.

platform.description: Platform name: the Compose project, or the Kubernetes namespace.

context.description: The kubectl context the state was read from (--context); null on Docker Compose.

state.description: degraded when an enabled service or the router is starting, unhealthy, stopped or not deployed (exit code 3).

tags.description: Labels of the brick's manifest (api, graphql, database, ...), from platform.lock; empty when none.

router.description: The Cosmo router; null while no installed brick serves a subgraph.

undeclared.description: What the runtime runs under this platform's name that platform.json does not declare (for example a removed brick before the next up). Never counted in state.

problems.description: Problems of the declared state, the same as `plugbricks status` reports (exit code 1).

state.description: healthy: running and its health check passes. starting: not ready yet (health check or init containers pending). unhealthy: running but failing, crash-looping or unable to pull its image. stopped: exited, created but not started, or scaled to 0. not deployed: the runtime has nothing for it. unknown: running with no health check to tell, or a state plugbricks does not know; never counted as degraded.

mismatch.description: not-deployed: enabled in platform.json but absent from the runtime. not-declared: present in the runtime but not in platform.json.

reason.description: Short and fixed wording (an exit code, CrashLoopBackOff, an image pull error, a failing probe); null when healthy. Never a log line or a runtime message.

instances.description: Container names (Compose) or pod names (Kubernetes), sorted.

name.description: Runtime name: the Compose service or the Kubernetes Deployment, <brick>-<service>.

service.description: The service's name in its plugin.json; null when not declared.

enabled.description: Installed in platform.json. There is no switch to disable an installed brick yet: every installed one is enabled.

deployed.description: The runtime has a container or a Deployment for it, in any state.

subgraph.description: Serves a subgraph behind the router.

address.description: Compose: the host address it is published on, 127.0.0.1:<port>. Kubernetes: its ClusterIP Service, <cluster IP>:<port>. null when not deployed or not published at the moment it was read.

image.description: The pinned image reference plugbricks deploys.

digest.description: Digest of the image the runtime reports running; null when it reports none.

subgraphs.description: Each subgraph service the router calls, with its state, sorted by name.

external.description: The subgraphs that run elsewhere (D33): called at their address, not supervised by plugbricks, so with no state. Absent when there is none.
